gauge.note: An independent slice of REVOTT, anchored by its own Ztp. It is not derived from any other instance and stands on its own gauge. Unlike 24.50 and 85.32, Y = 34.918 is itself a key in the 400-key domain. The corpus carries a named reading EXE_TPDP.100D over the same positions; whether that reading and this slice are the same object is not established here.

sampled.why: Instantiated across the whole key domain. No real-world targets are attached and none are claimed.

relations.note: Observed separations between sibling slices, recorded because they are exact, not because any slice defines another.

unresolved.year_to_instant: The gauge fixes Ztp as a decimal year, 2018.2633…, not as an instant. REVOTT's year-to-instant convention is not in the files read here, so this epoch was calibrated against the slice whose Ztp/instant pair is known.
unresolved.fractional_day: This is the first slice whose separation is not a whole number of days: 1041.8, because Y carries three decimals. Under the calibration the fractional 0.8 of a day shifts the time of day to 06:40:41.739Z rather than the 11:28:41.739Z the other slices carry. That is an artefact of borrowing another slice's instant, not a claim about this one. The native convention would settle whether the time of day travels between slices at all.
